general.organizacion_importTitle: Governed import of establishment and post structure
general.organizacion_importPublishBlocked: Publishing disabled: this screen does not receive verified source, action, custody and publishing authority accreditation.
general.organizacion_importHelp: The JSON package must come from a governed source and contain a manifest and typed facts with no actor or organisation identities. Preparation does not accredit occupation, vacancies or publication. Reconciliation uses decisions with their own evidence. An uncertain response is retried with the same key and the same bytes; reloading the page loses that retry from memory.
general.organizacion_importReady: Select a source package to prepare a batch.

general.ficha_ayuda: Identity, the relationship and each source are resolved on the server with their own authorisation. Each section is queried when it is opened. Recognised service, courses and clock-ins have different authorities and effects; none of them automatically becomes seniority, points or payroll.

general.ficha_servicios_ayuda: Recognised periods, provenance and recognition actions. Three-year increments and entitlements are not calculated.
general.ficha_tiempo_ayuda: Cronos keeps clock-ins and time incidents. A clock-in does not accredit recognised service, seniority or financial accrual.
general.ficha_formacion_ayuda: Courses, attendance, completion and certificates; an enrolment does not by itself accredit a course or score points.
general.ficha_economia_ayuda: Receipts, bases and contributions by period once the payroll source confirms its specific access.
